title: Night-mode TOC styling does not follow the active reader theme
symptom: The chapter directory in night mode displayed light/default list surfaces and looked detached from the current reading theme.
root_cause: The TOC sheet used generic surface/list defaults instead of deriving colors from the active reader theme palette.
fix: Made TOC sheet colors and row styling theme-aware.
Aligned night-mode TOC visuals with the active reader palette rather than generic Material defaults.
impact: Theme consistency broke exactly when users switched modes to read comfortably, making the UI feel unfinished.
